one_line: Maratha kingmaker Mahadji Scindia and his European commander Benoit de Boigne, shaping disciplined brigades in late-18th-century North India.

appearance.age_look: Mahadji: late 40s–50s, lean but sturdy; De Boigne: late 30s–early 40s, tall and solidly built
appearance.face: Mahadji has an oval, weathered brown face with a neatly trimmed black mustache, faint battle scars on his right cheek and nose, and sharp, assessing eyes with thick brows; his default expression is calm authority with a hint of shrewdness. De Boigne has a slightly long, fair-to-light-olive face with a straight nose, short trimmed sideburns, and focused grey-blue eyes; his default expression is disciplined, alert seriousness.
appearance.hair: Mahadji’s hair is black, oiled and drawn back into a small knot hidden under a deep saffron-copper Maratha turban (pheta) with a subtle gold edge and a single small white feather tucked on the left; a thin gold forehead ornament (tikka-like strip) peeks beneath. De Boigne’s hair is dark brown, cut short in a late-18th-century European style with a slight wave and tied into a small low queue at the nape with a black ribbon; he wears no hat in the default look.
appearance.costume: Mahadji wears a full white cotton angarkha (wrap-over robe) with long sleeves and mid-calf length, faint self-stripe texture, and a wide deep-saffron silk patka (waist sash) with thin gold borders wrapped around his waist, the ends hanging at his left hip; beneath, he has slim white churidar trousers gathered at the ankles and soft brown leather mojari shoes with slightly upturned toes. Over his shoulders rests a lightweight, pale-cream shawl with a narrow maroon border and tiny paisley motifs, usually draped over his left shoulder and under his right arm; he has a simple, dignified olive-green wool sleeveless over-vest in cooler scenes but the default look keeps the angarkha visible. Jewellery is restrained: a single medium-thickness gold necklace close to the collarbone, small gold hoop earrings, and a plain gold ring on his right hand. De Boigne wears a dark navy-blue, knee-length European military coat (late-18th-century cut) with standing collar, brass buttons in a single row, and plain cuffs, over a cream-coloured waistcoat and off-white linen shirt with a modest, tied cravat; his trousers are beige-brown, straight and tucked into mid-calf black leather riding boots with simple straps. A narrow dark-red sash is tied around his waist under the coat, hinting at service under Maratha pay, and he carries a worn brown leather cross-belt for his weapon.
appearance.signature: Mahadji carries a gently curved, steel Maratha talwar in a plain dark-brown leather scabbard with simple brass fittings, worn at his left hip through his saffron patka; De Boigne carries a straight European officer’s sword with a brass hilt and simple knuckle-guard, hanging from his cross-belt at his left side.

ref_desc: Mahadji Scindia is a lean brown-skinned Maratha noble in a white angarkha, saffron turban and sash, modest gold jewellery and brown mojari shoes with a talwar at his hip, standing beside Benoit de Boigne in a navy European coat, beige trousers and black boots with a brass-hilted sword, both in white, saffron, navy, cream and brown tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of two characters together: Mahadji Scindia and Benoit de Boigne, designed to be redrawn consistently, showing face, hair, costume and weapons clearly. Mahadji is a late-40s to 50s, lean brown-skinned Maratha noble with an oval, weathered face, neat black mustache, faint scars on his right cheek and nose, sharp eyes and thick brows, wearing a deep saffron-copper Maratha turban with a subtle gold edge and a small white feather on the left, a thin gold forehead strip, and his black hair pulled back into a knot under the turban. He wears a long-sleeved, mid-calf white cotton angarkha with faint self-stripes, tied at the side, a wide deep-saffron silk patka with thin gold borders wrapped at his waist with the ends hanging at his left hip, slim white churidar trousers, and soft brown leather mojari shoes with slightly upturned toes; a pale-cream shawl with a narrow maroon border and tiny paisley motifs is draped over his left shoulder and under his right arm, and he has a single medium gold necklace, small gold hoop earrings and a plain gold ring. At his left hip sits a gently curved steel talwar in a plain dark-brown leather scabbard with brass fittings. Beside him, Benoit de Boigne is a late-30s to early-40s, tall, solidly built European with a slightly long light-olive face, straight nose, grey-blue eyes, short wavy dark-brown hair tied into a small low queue with a black ribbon, and short sideburns, wearing a dark navy knee-length late-18th-century military coat with standing collar and brass buttons over a cream waistcoat and off-white shirt with a modest cravat, beige-brown trousers and mid-calf black leather riding boots; a narrow dark-red sash is tied around his waist under the coat and a brown leather cross-belt supports a straight European officer’s sword with a brass hilt and simple knuckle-guard at his left hip. Use a colour palette dominated by deep saffron, white, navy blue, cream and brown leather, and pose them so both outfits and weapons are fully visible from head to toe against a simple neutral background.
